title: Big battles in the clan war
changes: Pitched battles are fought three times a day, at 13:00, 19:00 and 21:30 (Swiss time), and the Herald announces each one 30 minutes ahead. Stormings decide the biggest sieges, and big columns that meet on the road fight a battle too.
Hold the three banners on the field and cut down enemy captains to tip the battle your way.
Sworn heroes on the winning side earn gold, valor and renown, and the clan leaders have their say.
